extracted.name: Easy Peasy Vegetable Beef Soup
extracted.description: Growing up in an enlisted military family, my mom had to make meals stretch and she had to make it tasty enough to appeal to 3 finicky kids. This is one she would prepare a couple of days before pay day when the cupboard was getting bare.
ingredient_lines: 1 lb hamburger (more if you like a lot of meat)
1 reg can diced potatoes or 2 lg Idaho potatoes peeled and dice
1 reg can kidney or pinto beans
1 reg can diced tomatoes or can of stewed tomatoes
10-12 oz water or beef broth (if needed)
Lawrys seasoning salt, seasalt and pepper to taste
Optional - 1 sm onion quartered then halved and layered
instruction_lines: In a Dutch oven brown hamburger meat and drain then add onion if using and all seasonings. Mix together with meat well.
Add all canned ingredients (diced potato if using fresh). Also 12 oz of water if needed or beef broth. I prefer beef broth.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat to simmer, cover and cook for approx 1 hr to let all flavors fuse, stirring occasionally.
Serve with cornbread for a delicious hearty meal.
